name: Sprite
description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motivesTactics: let the poison do its work

abilities.name: Minion (5)
abilities.description: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Art of Invisibility
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

abilities.name: Dream Petal Poison
abilities.description: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.
